# [TASK] SonarQube Integration and Code Quality Cleanup

## Task
Wire SonarQube static analysis into the Gradle build with aggregate JaCoCo
coverage, then clear what it reports across the backend modules: fix what is a
real defect, and record a reason for what is not.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The Sonar plugin and the aggregate coverage input are wired in the root
      build, and CI runs the analysis on `main`
      (`grep -n "org.sonarqube\|sonar.coverage.jacoco.xmlReportPaths"
      build.gradle`, and the "SonarQube analysis" step in
      `.github/workflows/backend-ci.yml`)
- [x] The quality gate passes with no open bug, vulnerability or code smell
      (`./gradlew test jacocoTestReport sonar`, then the project's quality gate
      on the server)
- [x] The one real defect found, a daylight-saving error in
      `DateUtils.hoursBetween`, is fixed and pinned
      (`DateUtilsTest.hoursBetween_shouldCountRealElapsedHoursAcrossDaylightSaving`)
- [x] Line coverage stays at or above 80% per module
      (`./gradlew jacocoTestCoverageVerification`, run by
      `.github/workflows/backend-ci.yml`)
- [x] The accepted findings, the two deactivated rules and the quality profile
      are written down (no test: documentation,
      `docs/architecture/CODE_QUALITY.md`,
      `infrastructure/sonarqube/lmdb-way-java-profile.xml`)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 6-8

## Notes
The profile file was named `filmpire-way-java-profile.xml` here; it is
`lmdb-way-java-profile.xml`.

Analysis runs against SonarCloud in CI, on pushes to `main` only, because the
free plan stores results for the default branch alone. The local SonarQube
Community server behind the compose `sonar` profile is the same analysis run
by hand.

The coverage figure was written here as 84.8% over 4732 ncloc. That is one
measurement, not a criterion; the enforced gate is 80% per module (#108).

Two rules are deactivated repo-wide, S8694 and S8688; the reason is in
CODE_QUALITY.md.
